name: Kanro Inc.
summary: Kanro Inc. manufactures and sells confectionery and food products in Japan. The company offers candies, gummies, and confectionery ingredients. It also engages in digital commerce and design business. The company provides its products under the Kanro Ame, Kin no Milk, Kenko Nodoame, Sugar-Free, Puré Gummy, and Candemina brand names. It also manages stores under the HITOTUBU KANRO name. Kanro Inc. was founded in 1912 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
